segment.description: North Mouse Creek (GNIS 01295930), Hiwassee-basin (HUC-8 06020002) creek that the catalog calls the 'principal Cleveland-area waterway... locally important general-fishing creek'. The course runs from the Niota/Athens area in McMinn County (stations 03566115 'AT OLD ACME MILL NR NIOTA' 4.8 sq mi; 03566127 'AT ST HWY 30 NR ATHENS' 35 sq mi; 035661285 'NR ROCKY MT HOLLOW NR ATHENS' 42.1 sq mi at 775 ft; 03566129 'NEAR RICEVILLE' 51 sq mi; 03566132 'NEAR SANFORD' 55.8 sq mi) southwesterly to its Hiwassee River confluence near the McMinn/Bradley county line (mouth ~35.326, -84.803 per NHD) — the lower reach being the Cleveland-area/Bradley County waterway the catalog references. Distinct from South Mouse Creek and Little South Mouse Creek, which drain the Cleveland side and have their own (numerous) USGS stations.
segment.boundaries: Full named creek per NHD: headwaters near Niota/Athens (lat ~35.55) to the Hiwassee River mouth (~35.326, -84.803). The temperature evidence below is from the middle creek near Athens (42.1 sq mi), upstream of the cataloged Bradley County reach; no temperature station exists on the lower reach.

coldSource.notes: Valley creek at low elevation (775 ft at the Athens-area gauge, USGS 035661285), falling to the Hiwassee at the state-line valley floor; no dam, no spring-influence documentation, and no gorge/canyon shading documented. No agency statement of cold-water character was located.

holdover.detail: No trout presence of any kind is documented for the creek — no stocking program rows, no trout designation, no creel or survey records located — so holdover cannot be assessed.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found: zero 'North Mouse' rows in TWRA's stocking workbook, no entry on TWRA's wild-trout/special-regulation lists, and no fish-community inventory documenting trout was located (the water-quality literature found for the creek — EPA compendium and TDEC standards entries — concerns general monitoring, not trout).

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS grabs at 035661285 (42.1 sq mi, near Athens, 1995-2004, n=42) show July-August water of 18.5-27.0 degC — routinely at or above trout stress thresholds on a low-elevation (775 ft) valley creek with no trout stocking or designation.
